subject: MapleHealth — hosted API rate benchmarking & competitor mapping
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <buyer@maplehealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MapleHealth — hosted API rate benchmarking & competitor mapping

Hi Emily,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. As discussed, the procurement team asked us to provide a straightforward baseline comparison between Redwood's hosted API rate card and the competitors you've been evaluating (OpenAI, Anthropic, Together, AWS Bedrock). To get a tight proposal back to you quickly could you confirm:

- Expected monthly token volume (prompt + completion), or an average QPS target
- Typical context window (8k/32k/other) and model fidelity needs (latency-sensitive vs. highest-quality)
- Any must-have features (structured output, streaming, function calling, embeddings for search)
- Contract preference (month-to-month pilot vs. 12/24 month commit)

If you already have the competitor pricing in a spreadsheet, feel free to forward — that will speed things up. Our goal is to give you a direct per-unit comparison and, where possible, a matching or improved blended rate for hosted usage plus a recommended pilot that reduces risk.

I'll loop in Marissa (sales lead) and Dev (solutions) to prepare numbers once we have volume.

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Emily Carter <buyer@maplehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MapleHealth — hosted API rate benchmarking & competitor mapping

Jonas,

Thanks — attaching the snapshot we collected. Quick answers below.

- Volume: approx 35M tokens/month initially, expected to grow to ~120M over 12 months (pilot->prod).
- Context: 8k for most chat use cases, a few weekly jobs at 32k for batch summarization.
- Features: streaming responses for UI latency, function calling, embeddings for vector search (search latency less critical), SOC 2 and US data residency required.
- Contract: pilot first (30–60 days), then likely 12 month commit if pilot results are good.

Competitor snapshot (copied from our sourcing):
- OpenAI (gpt-4o-ish): blended $0.028/1k tokens (prompt+completion blended) for committed tier; $0.040/1k on pay-as-you-go.
- Anthropic (Claude-2 style): $0.024/1k tokens blended for term commit; $0.038/1k on demand.
- Together: $0.018–0.022/1k tokens for some community-backed models (volume dependent).
- AWS Bedrock (fp models): effective rate ~$0.035–0.045/1k tokens once runtime + infra is included.

I've attached the CSV we used. If you can come back with a single-page comparison and any matching options, that'll be perfect for our procurement.

Emily Carter
Head of ML Platforms, MapleHealth
buyer@maplehealth.com
Attachment: competitor_pricing_snapshot.csv
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Carter <buyer@maplehealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MapleHealth — hosted API rate benchmarking & competitor mapping

Marissa / Dev — forwarding Emily's competitor snapshot and volumes. Key asks: 35M -> 120M tokens/month, mostly 8k context with occasional 32k jobs, pilot then 12-month commit with SOC2 + US residency.

Thoughts on a competitive hosted baseline we can offer that preserves margin but is defensible vs. Anthropic/OpenAI:
- Blended hosted text generation (prompt+completion): propose $0.025/1k tokens for pilot (30–60d) with an option to step down to $0.019/1k at 100M+ committed monthly throughput.
- Embeddings: propose $0.0035 per embedding during pilot, $0.0025 at commit.
- Offer a 2-week free pilot credit to accelerate evaluation (equivalent to $5k usage credit).

Dev, please flag any constraints on supporting 32k jobs in hosted mode and side-effects on throughput/SLO. Emily: is the pilot credit acceptable or should we propose usage-based credits?

Thanks,
Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Carter <buyer@maplehealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MapleHealth — hosted API rate benchmarking & competitor mapping

Team / Emily — based on volumes and comparables, here's a clean, customer-friendly position we can send as a preliminary commercial: 

1) Pilot (30–60 days)
- Hosted blended generation: $0.025 per 1k tokens (prompt+completion blended)
- Embeddings: $0.0035 per embedding
- Pilot credit: $5,000 usage credit to be applied during pilot (reduces immediate spend risk)
- Deliverables: 1 security review call, access to SOC2 report, US region hosted endpoint

2) Post-pilot committed pricing (12-month standard)
- Tier A (>=50M tokens/mo): $0.021 per 1k tokens, embeddings $0.0028
- Tier B (>=100M tokens/mo): $0.019 per 1k tokens, embeddings $0.0025
- Optional add-on: Dedicated pool for predictable latency (SLA-backed) — pricing via separate quote (recommended for latency-sensitive paths)

Notes:
- We can include a 30% discount on overage for the first 3 months post-commit as a goodwill buffer while they scale.
- Pricing includes streaming and function calling; 32k context support will require a small performance premium for sustained heavy usage — Dev, please add the numeric impact if needed.

Emily — if this is aligned I can push a formal PDF quote and an initial SOW. Legal will provide our standard T&Cs but we're open to commercial redlines for enterprise procurement.

Marissa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Emily Carter <buyer@maplehealth.com>

Subject: Re: MapleHealth — hosted API rate benchmarking & competitor mapping

Thanks, Marissa — high level that looks good. A few follow-ups before we take internal approval:

- Please send a formal quote (PDF) with the pricing table and a short description of what is included in the pilot credit.
- We need SOC2 Type II report and answers to a handful of questions in our security questionnaire (I'll attach when procurement prompts me).
- Data residency — must be US only for now. Do you support regional restrictions and contractual commitments?
- Contract term: if we commit to Tier B (>=100M tokens/mo) we'd likely want normalized pricing over 12 months and a 60–90 day termination for cause clause.

Also, we typically request a small signing credit (one-time) in addition to pilot credits; can you include that in the quote as a line item?

Emily
Attachment: security_questionnaire_inbound.docx (to follow)

3) If pilot metrics meet agreed success criteria, we move to a 12-month commit at the Tier B rate ($0.019/1k blended) with standard SLAs; termination language to be discussed with legal.
4) Security questionnaire — please send when ready; Dev will coordinate the answers.

Proposed kickoff: 2027-04-04 10:00 AM PT for alignment and SOW review.
